item.title: NTI and HTP Brand Gas Boilers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire, Carbon Monoxide (CO) Poisoning and Impact Hazards; Manufactured by Ariston, formerly NTI Boilers
item.company: Ariston Canada Inc. (Formerly NTI Boilers Inc.), of Canada
item.brand: Ariston Canada Inc. (Formerly NTI Boilers Inc.), of Canada
item.product: NTI and HTP residential gas boilers
item.summary: This recall involves NTI brand residential gas boilers in the FTVN and TFTN model series, and HTP brand residential gas boilers in the EFTU model series. The NTI FTVN and TFTN series boilers are gray, while the HTP EFTU (Elite Fire Tube Ultra) boilers are black. The boilers are metal, rectangular units and have either NTI or HTP printed on the front. The model serial number can be found on the rating plate, located on the left-hand side of the boiler. The following models and serial number ranges are included in this recall:
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: NTI and HTP residential gas boilers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled boilers immediately and contact Ariston to schedule a free repair by a certified technician. Consumers who must continue using the boiler while awaiting repair should have working smoke and carbon monoxide alarms in their homes.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
